inspected_anchors.finding: RECON constructs24 case files/1604 questions from deterministic provenance structure with LLM narration. Six tasks include invalidation, conflict and counterfactual-like timeline changes; generation contracts are not inferred intervention semantics.
Human validation states200 questions, three annotations each, majority match86.3%, clarity89.7%, sufficiency91.8%, faithfulness90.0%, ambiguous13.2%; exact denominators unresolved.

Main evaluation filters190 of1604 closed-book-guessable questions, leaving1414. Score, strict Accuracy, abstention and Tokens/Q differ. Oracle changes representation; poor temporal-fact results preclude universal upper-bound interpretation.

Header-based recall measures verbatim support and excludes Mem0/Graph; uniqueness93% overall/98% multi-hop is not perfect. Hit/miss performance is conditioned observationally, not a randomized causal retrieval effect.

Human baseline60 questions uses relevant evidence packets, unlike full-case/retrieved-context systems; non-significant narrator tests do not establish equivalence. Synthetic style/schema leakage and input asymmetry acknowledged.
Answer/judge prompts distinguish structured answers, abstention and cross-family free-form judges; two verdicts do not establish independent semantic truth.
Generator/provenance/semantic checks and human protocol are described; structural validity alone cannot assign every human disagreement to reasoning failure.
Scoring rules and snapshot examples, parsing retries, closed-book filter and RAG settings are explicit. Question bootstrap does not by itself justify inference over new cases.
Memory services have specified waits and configurations; waiting30/60/600 seconds is not observed durable index completion. Human per-task strict-majority rates need exact denominator reconciliation.
Per-model/domain scores, confusion taxonomies and robustness plots remain reported evidence, not replayed native results.

limitations: Primary-text and authored arithmetic review only; no downloaded code, benchmark harness, upstream package or live LLM executes.
Reported benchmark results are not reproduced; code, dataset, provider responses and model/service artifacts require separate custody.
No new image previews; text and raw extraction support selected anchors, not a new visual acceptance.
Denominator inconsistencies require exact row/weight/aggregation records; they do not establish fabrication.
A provenance dependency graph is not automatically an intervention SCM; public synthetic benchmark utility does not establish bank truth or adoption.

supported_claims: 86.3% cannot round from an unweighted binary majority rate over200;518/600 can but uses another denominator.
63.0% cannot be a rounded binary rate over60; several ten-item per-task reported percentages cannot be strict-majority rates.
Six-option random guessing has expected score0 but strict accuracy1/6; abstention has both0.
Selected1414-question population differs from initial1604; filter is not direct evidence of contamination.
Two independent cases with ten same-sign questions give mean variance1/2 versus incorrect1/20.
Identical observed binary law permits causal effect1 or0 under different structural equations.
